Hi all, just wanted to introduce myself. I'm working on a project to formalize the Eilenberg-Steenrod axioms for homology theories under @Johan Commelin, @Sander Dahmen and @Christian Merten. Just made my first PR! Happy to hear any feedback :)
https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36621

Welcome Jacob!

We should probably coordinate, as I already have completed quite a bit of work on the formalization of the EIlenberg-Steenrod axioms and some notable consequences (the Mayer-Vietoris sequence in particular). Still, there is quite a lot of low hanging fruit in this direction, and it is always nice to work with someone!

#new members > Looking for Differential Geometry Project @ 💬

See here: https://github.com/volfenstein1/EilenbergSteenrodAxioms

Some things need to be adjusted and cleaned up. In particular, it needs to be confirmed that the axioms as stated will interface cleanly with the constructions coming out of the formalization of singular homology.

Hi Wolfgang, good to hear someone else is thinking about this. I had a quick look at your repo and you are already farther than I am. That being said, there is already some feedback on the implementation of TopPair in my PR so I suggest we take that as a starting point. Could you have a look at it and add any thoughts/suggestions to the PR?

Here is my separate project where I am working on this. But apart from TopPair, it only contains my first steps in implementing the Eilenberg-Steenrod axioms. This is still very much WIP, so it might make more sense to continue with the implementation you came up with.
Also, does it make sense to make a separate channel where we can discuss this project?
Generally folk make a thread in #mathlib4 or #maths
